main.description: React to a document, a comment, or a post mirrored from the public network. A member of the subject's context may (the interim's rule for a reaction); anyone signed in may react to a public post. Once per emoji: a second tap changes nothing.

subject.description: A document's or a comment's id, or a mirrored post's at-uri.

emoji.description: An emoji: short, not plain text.

id.description: The reaction's id (stable across idempotent re-adds).

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: Nothing there to react to, or nothing the caller may read.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller may read the subject and is not a member of its context.
